assets.caption: Fig. 1400-27 Guidelines for Control Valve Packings (2 of 2)

footnotes: (1) Pre-formed ring packing is required for new valves. Coiled packing and split-ring packing is not acceptable. Packing systems shall be designed to operate without need for lubrication.

(2) Valve packing gland should be furnished with a lantern ring. Packing gland shall be drilled at the lantern ring then tapped to accept a lubricator and isolating valve assembly. If a lubricator and isolating valve are specified on the control valve datasheet they shall be supplied at the factory by the manufacturer. If lubricator and isolating valve are not specified, the tapped connection shall be plugged with a removable piping plug.
(3) Manufacturer's standard five-ring solid Teflon® or Teflon® Chevron Vee-Ring packing.
(4) Manufacturer's standard five-ring graphitic packing, Fisher Hi-Seal™, or equal.
(6) DuPont Kalrez® Valve Stem Packing, Fire-Safe Series only.
(7) Fisher Enviro-Seal™ graphitic packing or equal.
